>
[Quickstrike](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2844)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 238

**Price** 10,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto a weapon

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Attacks with a _quickstrike_ weapon are supernaturally swift. While wielding a _quickstrike_ weapon, you gain the [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) condition, but you can use the additional action granted only to make a Strike with the etched weapon.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
